claims.statement: Observation projection keeps a stable handle and source locator to the unreduced evidence.
Large observations may use excerpts or summaries for runtime efficiency while preserving the route back to full evidence.
Reduction without a verifiable receipt or stable source can create irrecoverable pseudo-memory.

mechanisms.description: create an observation pack with source locator and stable handle
mechanisms.name: mechanism_1

mechanisms.description: retain excerpt/full selection according to bounded thresholds
mechanisms.name: mechanism_2

mechanisms.description: bind destructive reduction to a reducer receipt when policy requires it
mechanisms.name: mechanism_3

notes: This object is retrieval knowledge only and grants no runtime, tool, routing, memory-write, learning-promotion, execution, or policy authority.
content.summary: Large observations may be compacted into bounded projections only after the reduced form is tied to stable source locators and, when required, a reducer/verification receipt so compaction does not destroy evidentiary recoverability.
